texts.en:
Surveyed worlds sometimes possess unique properties that make them valuable objects of research. These £physics£ Physics, £society£ Society or £engineering£ Engineering resources can be collected by a £science_ship£ Research Station. My programming strongly compels me to compel you to build one.

Keep in mind that Research Stations can only be built within our borders, and have a upkeep cost in £energy£ Energy Credits.
